links.comparator_used: Bot1 (standard GPT-3.5 without retrieval) vs Bot2 (GPT-3.5 with retrieval from two clinical guidelines via DocsBot)
links.outcome: Proportion of responses recommending consultation vs pharmacological interventions for cancer survivors' sexual health questions
links.effect: Consultation was more prevalent than pharmacological interventions in both bots: OR 47.3 (p<0.001) in Bot1 and OR 97.2 (p<0.001) in Bot2; no direct statistical test between bots reported
links.tradeoff: Guideline retrieval did not correct the bias; guideline recommendations were not reflected in responses and the bias toward non-pharmacological advice persisted.
links.quote: Despite the lack of reflection on guideline recommendations, 'consultation' was significantly more prevalent in both bots' responses compared with pharmacological interventions, with ORs of 47.3 (p<0.001) in Bot1 and 97.2 (p<0.001) in Bot2.
